name: phase-a
about: Phase A of docs/ai-playtest-plan.md: one truck and one cart run by their crews from the Hell's Kitchen commissary for a week. The truck works the district's three premium spots (data/pitches.json); the cart three buildings near the commissary, since a pushed cart walks between stops. Every stop takes the default hours (from 11:00, three hours each, as the map pick gives them). A fresh character can't pay for a truck, so the run starts the books at starting_money (set with the bridge's money, before the first snapshot); the licence and permits come from the debug action, free.

changes.why: a player copies Monday's route onto Saturday
a player starts the cart's Sunday shift an hour earlier
